assumptions: The successor is an OPEN existential, not a positive truth. `superseded_by` names the proposition that survives the refutation, and that proposition is unsettled.
REFUTED here is about COVERAGE, the weaker and decidable half. Whether the covered fragment is semantics-preserving is not addressed, and could not be — see ASR-COMPILE-PRESERVES.
attrs.evidence: GPT-5.6's adjudication, after four rounds of asking, and it splits a question this artifact had been carrying as one. The compilation does not represent all source relations: the running gate reports that 28 defeaters attack no argument node, their targets being assumptions, claims, claim_evidence, consumption_rules, evidence and receipts, and every one of them is placed in `outside`. That instrumentation is good and it is also the refutation — a compilation that drops a quarter of the attack relation into a bucket labelled `outside` is not a compilation of the whole graph. The witness RUNS, which is what this ledger reserves REFUTED for.
attrs.prior_art: GPT-5.6, ruling on INV-R7.3. SRC-ASPIC-2014 for what a structured-to-abstract compilation has to do with premise attacks — undermining and undercutting are how attacks on premises and rules become attacks on derived arguments, and reifying claim/evidence/assumption/rule/receipt into argument structures is the available route.

readjudicated.method: historical_refutation_preserved — refutation_scope names a source-lane revision and stays a fact about that revision
readjudicated.note: The source-lane status is recorded in imported_from.source_status as provenance. This field records that the TARGET lane re-established it; the two are separate facts and the gate reads this one.

attrs.review_focus: The refutation is cheap and the repair is not. Reifying premises into argument structures is a design GPT-5.6 has sketched and nobody has built, and doing it would change what every label in §9 means.
attrs.statement: The compilation implemented by compileAF() is a semantics-preserving compilation of the complete typed Mosaic assurance graph.
